Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3).
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> FareConfirm (capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId; re-inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld per section 4.7 step 2; assert price reconciliation) -> Book (Supplier/supplier, credentialsSelector, fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId, passengersList, contactsList; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> Void (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; only expected to succeed if voidCapability is not "VoidNotAllowed")

Family A's checks hold through the first Retrieve; Void is only expected to succeed if Book's voidCapability is not "VoidNotAllowed" and the (unknown, confirm-live) void window has not elapsed; a follow-up Retrieve after Void shows a voided/cancelled bookingStatus.

Preconditions
Supplier=Emirates, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Hold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3).
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> FareConfirm (capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId; re-inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld per section 4.7 step 2; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> BookAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; assert returned pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold -- same-PNR invariant, section 2.13) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3)
Expected Result
Family B's checks hold through the first Retrieve; after BookAfterHold, the second Retrieve shows bookingStatus transitioning held to booked; pnr, bookingToken and gdsPNR returned by BookAfterHold are byte-for-byte unchanged from Hold's values (same-PNR invariant, section 2.13/6.3).

Preconditions
Supplier=AirCairo, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Hold, Void. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). NOTE: AirCairo's Hold capability is flagged as conflicting/unknown between source documents (SPEC section 4.4/4.6) -- the section 4.7 live confirmation step above is mandatory here, not optional, before scheduling this flow.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> FareConfirm (capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId; re-inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld per section 4.7 step 2; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> BookAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; assert returned pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold -- same-PNR invariant, section 2.13) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> Void (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; only expected to succeed if voidCapability is not "VoidNotAllowed")
Expected Result
Family D's checks hold (held-to-booked transition, same-PNR invariant through BookAfterHold); Family C's Void checks then apply to the now-finalized ex-Held booking -- Void expected to succeed only if voidCapability allows it, and a follow-up Retrieve shows a voided/cancelled bookingStatus.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier=SabreNDC, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Hold, CancelHold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3).
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> FareConfirm (capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId; re-inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld per section 4.7 step 2; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> CancelAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; SPEC section 2.14 -- zero script coverage, weakest-validated endpoint)
Expected Result
Family B's checks hold through the first Retrieve; after CancelAfterHold, a follow-up Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- SPEC section 2.14 flags CancelAfterHold as having zero script coverage and no genuine example response in either collection, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole flow set; treat the exact response shape as UNKNOWN pending live confirmation and record the first observed value as the new baseline.
Actual Result
Failed checks: Search price reconciliation incl. the tax-item sum (taxesAndFees missing on every passenger type, so rule 1 cannot hold); paxTotalAmount present on every Search passengerFareBreakdown entry; Retrieve after CancelAfterHold shows a cancelled/terminated state (state: no tickets, no hold date; bookingStatus ABSENT); bookingStatus absent on V1 Retrieve (the flow row asserts it). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.

Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> Upselling (requestUrl fix applied; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId in place of FareConfirm's output; assert price reconciliation) -> Book (Supplier/supplier, credentialsSelector, fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId, passengersList, contactsList; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> Void (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; only expected to succeed if voidCapability is not "VoidNotAllowed")

Preconditions
Supplier=Emirates, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Hold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> Upselling (requestUrl fix applied; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId in place of FareConfirm's output; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> BookAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; assert returned pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold -- same-PNR invariant, section 2.13) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3)
Expected Result
Family B's checks hold through the first Retrieve; after BookAfterHold, the second Retrieve shows bookingStatus transitioning held to booked; pnr, bookingToken and gdsPNR returned by BookAfterHold are byte-for-byte unchanged from Hold's values (same-PNR invariant, section 2.13/6.3).

Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL. Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> Upselling (requestUrl fix applied; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId in place of FareConfirm's output; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> BookAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; assert returned pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR are unchanged from Hold -- same-PNR invariant, section 2.13) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> Void (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName, voidTickets=[]; only expected to succeed if voidCapability is not "VoidNotAllowed")

Family D's checks hold (held-to-booked transition, same-PNR invariant through BookAfterHold); Family C's Void checks then apply to the now-finalized ex-Held booking -- Void expected to succeed only if voidCapability allows it, and a follow-up Retrieve shows a voided/cancelled bookingStatus.

Preconditions
Supplier=SabreNDC, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Hold, CancelHold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> Upselling (requestUrl fix applied; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId in place of FareConfirm's output; assert price reconciliation) -> Hold (same fields as Book; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName; assert price has not drifted from Hold; must occur before holdExpirationDate) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3) -> CancelAfterHold (pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; SPEC section 2.14 -- zero script coverage, weakest-validated endpoint)
Expected Result
Family B's checks hold through the first Retrieve; after CancelAfterHold, a follow-up Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- SPEC section 2.14 flags CancelAfterHold as having zero script coverage and no genuine example response in either collection, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole flow set; treat the exact response shape as UNKNOWN pending live confirmation and record the first observed value as the new baseline.
Actual Result
Failed checks: Search price reconciliation incl. the tax-item sum (taxesAndFees missing on every passenger type, so rule 1 cannot hold); paxTotalAmount present on every Search passengerFareBreakdown entry; Upselling returns selectedOffer (documented drop-in for FareConfirm); Retrieve after CancelAfterHold shows a cancelled/terminated state (state: no tickets, no hold date; bookingStatus ABSENT); bookingStatus absent on V1 Retrieve (the flow row asserts it). Search price reconciliation incl. the tax-item sum (taxesAndFees missing on every passenger type, so rule 1 cannot hold): FAILED | paxTotalAmount present on every Search passengerFareBreakdown entry: FAILED | Upselling returns selectedOffer (documented drop-in for FareConfirm): FAILED | Upselling upsellOffers[0] price reconciliation: ok | capability flags: canBeHeld=true haveBundles=false; voidCapability=VoidNotAllowed | Hold price reconciliation (OK: all checks hold; total 61338.8 EGP): ok | PnrReprice price equals Hold price and reconciles: ok | Retrieve shows a held state (no tickets) with a future holdExpirationDate (2026-10-30T21:59:00): ok | CancelAfterHold returns cancelled:true: ok | Retrieve after CancelAfterHold shows a cancelled/terminated state (state: no tickets, no hold date; bookingStatus ABSENT): FAILED | bookingStatus on Retrieve: ABSENT (assertion named by the row cannot be made)

Supplier=AirArabia, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Bundle. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId; inspect offers[0].haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary per section 4.7 step 1) -> Upselling (requestUrl fix applied; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId in place of FareConfirm's output; assert price reconciliation) -> GetOfferBundles (thread fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId through directly -- do not rely on JourneyKey1, section 2.4 defect; select a bundle code, e.g. from bundleChoices) -> Book (Supplier/supplier, credentialsSelector, fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId, passengersList, contactsList, selectedBundles=[chosen bundle code]; assert price reconciliation; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability) -> Retrieve (pnr, gdsPnr, bookingToken; assert bookingStatus matches the expected lifecycle stage for this point in the flow, section 2.11/6.3)
Expected Result
Retrieve shows bookingStatus=booked (record exact observed enum value as baseline, section 2.11); selectedOffer.offerId and priceDetails.totalAmount match between Book's response and the follow-up Retrieve; price reconciliation (per-passenger-type tax/base/total formula, section 2.1/6.2) holds at Search, FareConfirm/Upselling, and Book. Bundle state: final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and bundle-included services (baggage/seat/meal) are not separately double-charged (SPEC section 6.4 BDL).
Actual Result
Blocked: the flow needs Bundle enrichment (GetOfferBundles) and SabreNdc/EGY offers no bundles: haveBundles=false on every offer, and V1 GetOfferBundles answers 409 OperationNotSupported (re-confirmed this round; the same fault is executed in FLOW-V1-15-NEG).

Preconditions
Supplier=TravelportNdc, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Run Search #1 and Search #2 independently (different searchResponseId/offerId pairs) -> FareConfirm/Upselling Search #1's offer normally (capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId#1) -> at Book, substitute Search #2's offerId in place of selectedOfferId#1 while keeping fareConfirmResponseId from Search #1 -> observe Book's response.
Expected Result
Book is expected to reject the mismatched offer/response ID pair (SPEC section 2.9 Negative Cases, section 3.2 "Search -> FareConfirm/Upselling" validation rules) rather than silently booking against the wrong offer. Exact status code is UNKNOWN -- SPEC section 7.9 flags that no error-response example exists in either collection; confirm live and record the actual behavior/status code as the new baseline rather than assuming a 4xx.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier=Emirates, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Hold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Do NOT apply the local requestUrl fix described in SPEC section 2.3 -- leave requestUrl unset/empty in STAG_ENV as shipped -> run Search normally -> attempt Upselling as-is (request uses {{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling) -> observe the resulting URL/request.
Expected Result
Because requestUrl is an empty, unset collection variable in the shipped STAG_ENV (SPEC section 1.4/2.3), the request resolves to a malformed URL with an empty host. Expected result is a connection/DNS/malformed-URL-class failure at the HTTP layer, distinct from any API-level 4xx -- confirm the exact client-side error live and record it; this is a real, evidenced collection defect, not a guessed negative path.
Actual Result
Defect confirmed: the shipped request fails at the HTTP client with no API response. Collection request URL "{{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling"; STAG_ENV has requestUrl: false; collection variable requestUrl = "". Resolved URL "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" -> client error "Failed to parse URL from api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (Invalid URL)". With requestUrl = baseUrl: Upselling 200.

Preconditions
Supplier=SabreNDC, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Hold, CancelHold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL.
Steps
  1. Do NOT apply the local requestUrl fix described in SPEC section 2.3 -- leave requestUrl unset/empty in STAG_ENV as shipped -> run Search normally -> attempt Upselling as-is (request uses {{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling) -> observe the resulting URL/request.
Expected Result
Because requestUrl is an empty, unset collection variable in the shipped STAG_ENV (SPEC section 1.4/2.3), the request resolves to a malformed URL with an empty host. Expected result is a connection/DNS/malformed-URL-class failure at the HTTP layer, distinct from any API-level 4xx -- confirm the exact client-side error live and record it; this is a real, evidenced collection defect, not a guessed negative path.
Actual Result
Defect confirmed: the shipped request fails at the HTTP client with no API response. Collection request URL "{{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling"; STAG_ENV has requestUrl: false; collection variable requestUrl = "". Resolved URL "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" -> client error "Failed to parse URL from api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (Invalid URL)". With requestUrl = baseUrl: Upselling 200.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier=FlyAdeal, credentialsSelector=UAE selected and confirmed live-capable per SPEC section 4.7 (Search then FareConfirm, inspect haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired flags) for this flow's required capabilities: Upsell, Bundle, Hold. Environment is non-production staging (STAG_ENV baseUrl); if Book/BookAfterHold is in this chain, production-booking auto-skip discipline (section 2.9 Testing Note) has been reviewed -- do not run against a production base URL without explicit authorization. Collection variables reset/cleared before start (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc. -- section 6.1 item 3). V1 Upselling requestUrl/baseUrl defect (SPEC section 2.3) has been fixed locally in STAG_ENV (requestUrl set equal to baseUrl) before this flow is run -- do NOT assume it is already fixed; if unfixed, Upselling will resolve to a malformed/empty-host URL. NOTE: FlyAdeal's Hold(unknown) capability is flagged as conflicting/unknown between source documents (SPEC section 4.4/4.6) -- the section 4.7 live confirmation step above is mandatory here, not optional, before scheduling this flow.
Steps
  1. Do NOT apply the local requestUrl fix described in SPEC section 2.3 -- leave requestUrl unset/empty in STAG_ENV as shipped -> run Search normally -> attempt Upselling as-is (request uses {{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling) -> observe the resulting URL/request.
Expected Result
Because requestUrl is an empty, unset collection variable in the shipped STAG_ENV (SPEC section 1.4/2.3), the request resolves to a malformed URL with an empty host. Expected result is a connection/DNS/malformed-URL-class failure at the HTTP layer, distinct from any API-level 4xx -- confirm the exact client-side error live and record it; this is a real, evidenced collection defect, not a guessed negative path.
Actual Result
Defect confirmed: the shipped request fails at the HTTP client with no API response. Collection request URL "{{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling"; STAG_ENV has requestUrl: false; collection variable requestUrl = "". Resolved URL "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" -> client error "Failed to parse URL from api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (Invalid URL)". With requestUrl = baseUrl: Upselling 200.

Preconditions
A valid searchResponseId + offerId pair is available from a prior Search call (any supplier). STAG_ENV loaded as shipped, requestUrl variable NOT overridden.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> send Upselling exactly as saved in the V1 collection (URL template {{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling) with requestUrl left empty -> observe the literal outgoing request URL and the resulting client/server behavior.
Expected Result
The resolved request URL has an empty host segment (e.g. "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" with no scheme/host prepended) because requestUrl is an empty, unset collection variable in the shipped STAG_ENV and is never populated by any other request (section 1.4, 2.3). Preconditions
A valid fareConfirmResponseId + selectedOfferId pair for a 1 ADT + 1 INF search. Non-production environment.

Preconditions
A valid fareConfirmResponseId + selectedOfferId pair for a 1 ADT + 1 INF search (passenger mix declared at Search matches what is submitted here, per section 2.5 Request Rules). Non-production environment; Book execution authorized per section 2.9.
Steps
  1. Search (ADT=1, INF=1) -> FareConfirm -> Book with the passengersList/contactsList described in Test Data, selectedBundles=[] -> Retrieve.
Expected Result
Book succeeds (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR returned); Retrieve's passengersList echoes the submitted names/types/document numbers unchanged (section 6.3 Family A Expected passenger state); the INF entry's ParentPaxRefId correctly resolves to the ADT entry in the response; no rejection despite this shape being untested by either collection's own saved examples (every saved V1 Book request in the collection ships passengersList/contactsList empty, section 2.9 -- this test supplies the missing coverage).
Actual Result
Book RVUAHT; Retrieve echoes 2 passengers: names/types/document numbers equal (case-insensitive): true; infant parentPaxRefId "Passenger1" resolves to the adult key "Passenger1": true; normalised on echo: documentType "Passport" (sent PASSPORT), gender "Male" (sent male), contact phone type/code and address are not echoed as sent

View Test Case
Preconditions
None beyond a valid supplier/credentialsSelector pair (Search is the entry point, section 2.1).
Steps
  1. Search with the given passenger mix -> for every offer in offers[] and every entry in passengerFareBreakdown, compute: sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) and compare to paxTotalTaxAmount.amount; sum((paxBaseAmount.amount + taxes) * paxCount) across passenger types and compare to priceDetails.totalAmount.amount; compare priceDetails.totalBaseAmount.amount to sum(paxBaseAmount * paxCount); compare priceDetails.totalTaxAmount.amount to sum(taxes * paxCount).
Expected Result
All four reconciliations hold exactly for every offer returned. This is enforced by the V1 Search collection script itself (SPEC section 2.1 Business Logic -- proven, not inferred), so a manual pass should reproduce a pass; any mismatch is a genuine regression, not a coverage gap (contrast with V2 Search, where this same check is a script coverage gap per section 1.10 item 4).
Actual Result
20 offers: totals/base/tax/paxTotal reconcile on 20/20; tax line items (rule 1) missing on 20/20 offers; paxTotalAmount present on all: false - the item-sum rule cannot hold because taxesAndFees is null on every passenger type (BUG-14)

View Test Case
Preconditions
None beyond a valid supplier/credentialsSelector pair.
Steps
  1. Search with a passenger mix totaling 10 across ADT+CHD+INF combined (e.g. ADT=6, CHD=2, INF=2) -> observe response. Follow up with a control run at exactly 9 total (e.g. ADT=5, CHD=2, INF=2) to confirm the boundary is exactly at 9, not 10.
Expected Result
The 10-passenger request is rejected -- SPEC section 2.1 states the 9-total-passenger cap is a confirmed business rule, not inferred from the collections, and section 7.8 names 10-passengers as the primary negative/boundary case for this rule. Exact rejection point (4xx at Search itself vs. accepted-then-rejected downstream) is UNKNOWN per section 2.1 -- confirm live and record. The 9-total control run is expected to succeed.

10 passengers: rejected 400 code=NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 msg="Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again." ctx=[{"Name":"PredicateValidator","Value":"Total passenger count cann | 9-passenger control: 200, 20 offers
Findings8Defects9Unknown-resolution
Defect — BUG-14, 3rd confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 Search offers carry no tax line items (offer-level taxesAndFees [] and per-passenger taxesAndFees null) although paxTotalTaxAmount/totalTaxAmount are populated, so reconciliation rule 1 (sum of tax items = paxTotalTaxAmount) cannot hold at Search. (sec.2.1, sec.2.2, sec.2.9, sec.2.11, sec.4.7, sec.5, sec.6.1, sec.6.2, sec.6.3-Family-A, FLOW-V1-01)
Field: offers[].passengerFareBreakdown[].taxesAndFees
Expected value: taxesAndFees[] with one entry per tax code, summing to paxTotalTaxAmount
History: First confirmed in Round 1 (TC-SEARCH-BIZ-02, 2026-10-25); again earlier in this round
Impact: The V1 collection script that enforces the item-sum check would fail for SabreNdc; reconciliation is only possible on totals until FareConfirm.
Evidence: taxesAndFees null on every passengerFareBreakdown entry of the selected offer
Defect — BUG-15, 1st confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 RetrieveBooking has no bookingStatus field at all (not null, absent) on SabreNdc/EGY, so no V1 flow can assert the booked / held / cancelled / voided state the flow rows name; the state can only be inferred from tickets[] and holdExpirationDate. (sec.2.1, sec.2.2, sec.2.9, sec.2.11, sec.4.7, sec.5, sec.6.1, sec.6.2, sec.6.3-Family-A, FLOW-V1-01)
Field: bookingStatus
Expected value: "bookingStatus": "Booked" | "Held" | "Cancelled" | "Voided" on every Retrieve
Impact: Callers cannot distinguish a held, cancelled and unknown booking from the Retrieve response; the primary state assertion of every V1 flow cannot be made. Same defect as BUG-01 of the 2026-08-05 TravelportNdc V1 run. See full bug report.
Evidence: Retrieve top-level keys: tickets, creationDate, ticketingDate, fareType, bookedCredentialsSelector, holdExpirationDate, pcc, supplier, pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, journeys, flightSegments, priceClasses, baggageDetails, passengersList, contacts, selectedOffer, isBspCommissionApplied, diRemarks
Defect — BUG-06, 8th confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 Retrieve after a successful CancelAfterHold returns 200 with no tickets and no hold date and no status field, so a cancelled hold is indistinguishable from a booking that was never ticketed (state: no tickets, no hold date; bookingStatus ABSENT). (sec.2.1, sec.2.2, sec.2.9, sec.2.10, sec.2.12, sec.2.11, sec.2.14, sec.4.7, sec.5, sec.6.1, sec.6.2, sec.6.3-Family-F, FLOW-V1-06)
Field: Retrieve after CancelAfterHold
Expected value: a cancelled / terminated state (or a 409 "reservation is already cancelled" as recorded for TravelportNdc)
History: First confirmed in the SabreNdc Void run (2026-10-22, TC-VOID-BIZ-04); again in Round 1 (TC-CANCELHOLD-REG-01, FLOW-V2-30, FLOW-V2-78); again earlier in this round
Impact: Cancelled holds look like live, unticketed bookings to monitoring and cleanup jobs.
Evidence: state: no tickets, no hold date; bookingStatus ABSENT
Defect — BUG-16, 1st confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 Upselling returns no selectedOffer: the response is {responseId, supplier, journeys, flightSegments, priceClasses, baggageDetails, upsellOffers[]}. SPEC 2.3 and the ID-chaining cheatsheet document Upselling as a drop-in for FareConfirm (selectedOffer.offerId -> selectedOfferId), so the documented chaining breaks and there is no rule for which upsell tier to use. (sec.2.1, sec.2.2, sec.2.3, sec.2.9, sec.2.11, sec.4.7, sec.5, sec.6.1, sec.6.2, sec.6.3-Family-A, FLOW-V1-07)
Field: selectedOffer (Upselling)
Expected value: "selectedOffer": { "offerId": "...", "priceDetails": { ... } } in the same shape as FareConfirm
Impact: Every Upselling-based V1 flow needs a manual workaround (this run uses upsellOffers[0], which carries the same fare as the searched offer). Same defect as BUG-08 of the 2026-08-05 TravelportNdc V1 run. See full bug report.
Evidence: Upselling response keys: responseId, supplier, journeys, flightSegments, priceClasses, baggageDetails, upsellOffers
Defect — BUG-17, 1st confirmed occurrence (not new)
The V1 collection sends Upselling to {{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling, but requestUrl is not defined in STAG_ENV and is empty in the collection, so the request URL has no host and cannot be sent. Every V1 Upselling test and flow needs a local override first. Collection request URL "{{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling"; STAG_ENV has requestUrl: false; collection variable requestUrl = "". Resolved URL "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" -> client error "Failed to parse URL from api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (Invalid URL)". With requestUrl = baseUrl: Upselling 200. (sec.2.1, sec.2.2, sec.2.3, sec.2.9, sec.2.10, sec.2.12, sec.2.11, sec.4.7, sec.5, sec.6.1, sec.6.2, sec.6.3-Family-B, sec.7.2, sec.7.7, sec.8.2, FLOW-V1-08-NEG)
Field: {{requestUrl}} (V1 collection, Upselling)
Expected value: URL template {{baseUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (as every other V1 request uses)
Impact: V1 Upselling cannot be run from the shipped collection and environment; anyone running the V1 suite hits a client-side URL error with no API response. See full bug report.
Evidence: Collection request URL "{{requestUrl}}api/FlightSearch/UpSelling"; STAG_ENV has requestUrl: false; collection variable requestUrl = "". Resolved URL "api/FlightSearch/UpSelling" -> client error "Failed to parse URL from api/FlightSearch/UpSelling (Invalid URL)". With requestUrl = baseUrl: Upselling 200.
Defect — BUG-19, 1st confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 Book accepts an infant without a valid adult parent reference and tickets it: ParentPaxRefId omitted: ACCEPTED, pnr RPQRUY | ParentPaxRefId = Pax9 (not in passengersList): ACCEPTED, pnr RWMMGM (sec.2.5, sec.3.2, sec.7.7, sec.8.1-item4, TC-BOOK-NEG-01)
Field: ParentPaxRefId
Expected value: 4xx validation error
Impact: An infant can be ticketed unattached, which airlines reject at check-in. See full bug report.
Evidence: ParentPaxRefId omitted: ACCEPTED, pnr RPQRUY | ParentPaxRefId = Pax9 (not in passengersList): ACCEPTED, pnr RWMMGM
Defect — BUG-20, 1st confirmed occurrence (not new)
V1 Book accepts a contactRefId that is not a key of contactsList and tickets the booking: ACCEPTED, pnr RTNGQG: an unresolved contactRefId is not checked (sec.2.5, sec.3.2, sec.7.7, sec.8.1-item4, TC-BOOK-NEG-02)
Field: contactRefId
Expected value: 4xx validation error
Impact: A passenger can be ticketed with no resolvable contact details. See full bug report.
Evidence: ACCEPTED, pnr RTNGQG: an unresolved contactRefId is not checked
